absentEvidence.capture: No capture-time/duration numeric field in persisted transport or metric names.
absentEvidence.relayQueue: No relay-queue numeric field in persisted transport or metric names.
absentEvidence.packetLoss: No packets-lost/packet-loss field. framesDropped is a decoded-frame counter and cannot establish packet loss.
absentEvidence.oneWayOrEndToEnd: Not established. No one-way, capture-to-display, or input-to-visible latency inferred from RTT/rolling metrics.

semanticsLimits: numericObservationCount counts saved rows with numeric values, not unique packets/frames or underlying metric samples.
Min/max are extrema of saved values, not complete event distributions; no whole-run P95 reconstructed.
Rolling last values are application five-second window snapshots; their overlapping per-window counts are not added.
Transport cumulative counters are counters, not durations, rates or packet-loss percentages.
Browser and Python clocks remain separate. No cross-clock or one-way inference.
All six input metrics remain unavailable/null; no repeat statistics here. Native after-grace/business input/visible effect/physical display remain NOT_RUN.
Global R4 qualification remains failed-or-indeterminate at coverage stage.
